title: Lectures to My Students
introduction: In reply to many requests from those ministers who in their student days listened to my lectures, I submit a selection to the press.

chapters.title: The Minister's Self-watch
paragraphs: "Take heed unto yourself, and unto the doctrine." 1 Timothy 4:16
Every workman knows the necessity of keeping his tools in a good state of repair.
1. It should be our first care that we ourselves be saved men.
That a teacher of the gospel should first be a partaker of it is a simple truth (Daniel 12:3).
